# Membership evidence batch 04 — targeted retrieval

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**


WorkBuddy agent (AI), 24 October 23:50 to 25 October 00:30, Beijing time. Targeted searches for Montenegro, South Africa and Croatia produced no newly admissible primary FIFA decision. One contemporary newspaper lead was stored; production rules remained unchanged.

The newspaper supported a two-step Baltic sequence: provisional membership in December 1991, then formal admission on 3 July 1992. Lithuania's ten matches were consequently proposed as four unresolved during the provisional window and six member/partial afterward. Whether provisional status qualified under the study rule was a policy question, not solved by the newspaper itself.

The report also completed the 14-country list with Namibia and the Cayman Islands: five Namibian matches were proposed member/partial; one Cayman match before admission remained unresolved/partial. South Africa and Croatia retained prior proposals with another contemporary source. Montenegro's official date gap remained.

Coverage remained 148 task rows: three touched keys, 29 reviewed without new evidence and 116 not_reviewed. The batch reported 31 partial, one not_found, zero resolved and zero production rules.

The [review](../../../../../outputs/logs/team_identity/batch-review-20261025-batch04/README.en.md) found a mismatch in the registered newspaper SHA despite the delivery's validation claim. Batch05 subsequently recorded a correction and validation report. Read the dated records together; do not silently overwrite the original claim.

No human/independent content review, FIFA originals, production rerun or full pytest occurred. The modern adopted sample is in the [identity guide](../../../../../研究/00_数据再次确认/README.en.md).
